related_papers.title: Compact binary waveform center-of-mass corrections
related_papers.relevance: Describes c.m. motion as gauge effect causing mode mixing in SXS waveforms; directly relevant to understanding subdominant mode errors
key_findings: C.m. motion is largely a gauge effect, not physical
Mode mixing from c.m. displacement affects subdominant modes
C.m. correction method based on apparent horizon trajectories

related_papers.title: Nonlinearities in Black Hole Ringdowns
related_papers.relevance: Shows second-order effects are necessary for modeling ringdown; quadratic (4,4) mode from (2,2) parent mode
key_findings: Nonlinear effects important for higher harmonics in ringdown
Quadratic (4,4) mode amplitude comparable to linear (4,4)
Improves mode mismatches by up to 2 orders of magnitude

related_papers.title: Surrogate models for precessing BBH simulations with unequal masses
related_papers.relevance: NRSur7dq4 surrogate model trained on 1528 SXS simulations; errors comparable to NR resolution errors
key_findings: Trained on 1528 simulations with q<=4, chi<=0.8
Model errors comparable to NR resolution errors
NR error estimated by comparing two highest resolutions

related_papers.title: Eccentric BBH surrogate models for waveform and remnant properties
related_papers.relevance: NRSur2dq1Ecc model for eccentric BBH; achieves mismatches ~1e-3
key_findings: First surrogate directly trained on eccentric NR simulations

additional_contract_items: Resolution convergence is the standard method for NR error estimation
Extrapolation to null infinity uses polynomial fits of different orders
Mode-by-mode error assessment is standard practice in SXS catalog papers
